commentary.text: 90+6' Peter Bankes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Peter Bankes blows the whistle, Frank Onyeka (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Nottingham get a free kick.
90+4' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Nottingham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.
89' The free kick from long range, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
89' Ola Aina (Nottingham) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
88' Rico Henry comes off the pitch to be replaced by Aaron Hickey (Brentford).
84' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ryan Yates (Nottingham) replacing Morgan Gibbs-White.
84' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' Igor Thiago (Brentford) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Nottingham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
79' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Jota Silva (Nottingham) replaces Dan Ndoye.
79' A substitution has been made. Chris Wood goes off and Igor Jesus (Nottingham) comes on.
78' 3 - 1 GOAL! Igor Thiago (Brentford) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Matz Sels.
78' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
78' Referee Peter Bankes is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Brentford!
77' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Brentford as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
76' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) handles the ball inside the penalty area. No point in arguing there. Brentford will take a penalty kick.
76' The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.
76' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.

76' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. Brentford force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
73' Matz Sels makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) after a cross from the side.
72' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Nottingham for a penalty. Play continues.
69' Keith Andrews prepares a substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
69' Substitution. Mathias Jensen walks off the pitch and Jordan Henderson (Brentford) comes on as a substitute.
68' Kevin Schade (Brentford) makes a slide tackle, but referee Peter Bankes blows for a foul. Nottingham win a free kick.

66' A precise low pass is received by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
65' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

64' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort flies narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.

62' A sweet pass finds Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Caoimhin Kelleher is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
62' Nottingham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

55' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
53' Neco Williams (Nottingham) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
52' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) for a tough tackle.
51' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fires a volley towards goal, but the ball sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
48' Flag goes up against Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Keith Andrews has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Kevin Schade comes on the pitch for Antoni Milambo (Brentford).
46' Referee Peter Bankes blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' 3 - 0 Goal! Elliot Anderson slips in Chris Wood (Nottingham) for a one-on-one with the keeper, and he simply dinks the ball over him into the net.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Poor challenge! Neco Williams (Nottingham) is penalised for tripping and Peter Bankes blows his whistle. Brentford are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
42' 2 - 0 Goal! Morgan Gibbs-White swings the ball deep into the box and finds Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the top left corner. 2:0.
41' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Peter Bankes had a clear view and blows his whistle. Nottingham will take a free kick.
41' Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
40' Igor Thiago (Brentford) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
39' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
39' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
36' The game is interrupted now, Igor Thiago (Brentford) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' None of the Nottingham players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
34' Surely that's handball by one of the Brentford players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nottingham, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Nottingham have a corner.
32' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Nottingham have a free kick.
30' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
27' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) tries to play a long through ball into Dan Ndoye, but the defence breaks the move down.
27' Matz Sels leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Mathias Jensen (Brentford).

24' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.

23' Ola Aina (Nottingham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
21' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher comes off his line to gather the ball.
21' Michael Kayode (Brentford) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
20' Michael Kayode (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

18' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off an easy save.
17' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

16' Ola Aina (Nottingham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
11' A lofted pass finds Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
11' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
9' Neat passing move from Nottingham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends a long ball in, but Caoimhin Kelleher comfortably gathers the ball.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Chris Wood (Nottingham) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the left post. 1:0.
5' The referee signals a corner kick to Nottingham.

5' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Nottingham will take a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
Nottingham will kick-off.
Peter Bankes will referee today's match.
